question: What is the percentage of the female patient whose uric acid (UA) beyond the normal range?
evidence: uric acid (UA) beyond the normal range refers to UA > 8.0 and SEX = 'M' or UA > 6.5 and SEX = 'F'; female refers to Sex = 'F'
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching Laboratory record.
gold: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.UA > 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'F'
gold0: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.UA > 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'F'

d.request: What percentage of female patients have a uric acid (UA) level above 6.5, while retaining patients with no matching Laboratory record in the results?
d.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.UA > 6.5 THEN p.ID END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID), 0) AS percentage FROM Patient AS p LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE UPPER(p.SEX) IN ('F', 'FEMALE');

b.request: What percentage of all female patients, including those with no Laboratory record, have at least one recorded UA value above 6.5?
b.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS l WHERE l.ID = p.ID AND l.UA > 6.5) THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS percentage FROM Patient AS p WHERE p.SEX = 'F';
